==Description==
The '''Party Crate''' is an exclusive [[Crate|crate]] that was obtainable during the [[Christmas 2019 Event]] from the [[Event Store]]. You could buy three crates for {{Tickets|3,000}} or {{Robux|225}}. You could not buy each crate individually. It was also obtainable from a [[Codes|code]] for Tower Defense Simulator's second and fifth anniversaries.

==Appearance==
{{Tabber
|Current
|The '''Party Crate''' resembles the look of a blue and black wooden box which was sealed shut. It contains gold on the inside. On its top is the standard shipping symbol indicating which side is up while on the front it had a party hat. It was opened with a crowbar.
|Version 2
|The second appearance of this crate was similar to the [[Basic Crate]], with the difference being the blue color of the box, party hat on the side of the box and a wrapped bow instead of tape.
|Version 1
|The first crate appearance was a blue gift, unlike other crates, including event ones.
}}

==Trivia==
[[File:Skincrate Open Error.png|200px|thumb|The error message prompted upon attempting to open the crate whilst it was unopenable. This bug has been fixed as of the 5th of June 2024.]]
*The '''Party Crate''' skins were originally supposed to be given out when the game came out of beta<ref>https://x.com/BelowNatural/status/1165096083455954944</ref>.
*The hats worn by {{Color|Party|Party}} skins are similar to the Club Penguin [[w:c:clubpenguin:Party Hat|Party/Beta Hat]].
*Unlike other [[crates]], you cannot buy the '''Party Crate''' in single installments.
**Additionally, you could not buy a second '''Party Crate''', the only crate with a purchase limit.
*Currently, this is the only event crate to return after an event ended.
**It has returned twice for the game anniversaries. 
*Any tower with the {{Color|Party|Party}} skin equipped will play the sound of a party whistle when placed.
*Despite being first obtainable from the [[Christmas 2019 Event]], the skins in this crate have a rarity of {{Color|Exclusive}} instead of {{Color|Event}}.
*The crate was not able to be opened for a portion of time, prompting the user with:
**"''ReplicatedStorage.Resources.SharedData.RarityWeight:24: attempt to perform arithmetic (mul) on nil and number''"
